name: Spring Sanctuary
summary: A water-drop contour shelters a compact mosque, joining renewal with prayer.
why: The drop uses x=54 as its axis, while the mosque dome and doorway align at x=52 to balance the right-hand minaret. The broad lower drop supports the mosque at y=75. The tower joins the hall in one connected silhouette, and the open gap above the roof keeps both forms readable.
risk: The water contour is the first impression and can also resemble a flame. At 24px the mosque remains a compact secondary detail inside it.
sub2: Architecture supported by the lower contour
reasonToChoose: You want a renewal theme with a distinct drop-shaped outline.

palette.name: SPRING SANCTUARY / DEEP BLUE + PEARL + AQUA
